description: Synthetic challenge authored before this slice was run. Fictional sources and relevance labels were authored together by an AI agent; no independent human review. Prior experiments on a separate fixture were known, so this is an additional exploratory slice, not a sealed benchmark or unbiased holdout. Relevance is source-level rather than chunk-span-level.

documents.text: The fictional Silver plan allows one return per month, within 21 days after delivery. The shipping fee is not refunded.
The fictional Gold plan allows two returns per month, within 45 days after delivery. Its standard shipping fee is refunded.
An exchange is not a return. For Silver and Gold plans, a size exchange must be requested within 10 days after delivery.
Fictional sensor model A-17 operates from -12 to 40 degrees Celsius and records a sample every 15 seconds.
Fictional sensor model A-71 operates from -20 to 35 degrees Celsius and records a sample every 15 minutes.
The fictional Cedar audit guide dated April 2022 requires retention of access logs for 90 days; it was superseded by the November 2024 guide.
The fictional Cedar audit guide effective November 2024 requires retention of access logs for 120 days. It supersedes the April 2022 guide.
Cedar incident-investigation logs are retained for two years; the ordinary access-log retention rule does not apply to them.
The fictional Aurora ferry leaves Pine Pier for Reed Island at 08:10 and 14:20 on weekdays. The listed times are departures.
The Aurora ferry leaves Reed Island for Pine Pier at 09:05, 12:00 and 17:30 on weekdays. These are departures, not arrivals.
For the fictional Helix assay A, use a red-cap collection tube and refrigerate the sample at 4 degrees Celsius.
For the fictional Helix assay B, use a blue-cap collection tube. Do not freeze it; refrigerate at 4 degrees Celsius.
The fictional Northstar Solo membership allows one household member to borrow up to five items.
The fictional Northstar Family membership permits four household members, and each household member may borrow up to three items.
The fictional Northstar library paper-book loan is 14 days. Paper books cannot be renewed if another member has placed a hold.
Northstar library DVD loans are seven days and cannot be renewed, whether or not another member has placed a hold.
काल्पनिक सूर्य संस्था में सालाना अवकाश 18 दिन है। एक साल के अंत में अधिकतम 4 अप्रयुक्त दिन अगले वर्ष जा सकते हैं।
काल्पनिक सूर्य संस्था में बीमारी की छुट्टी 10 दिन है। बीमारी की छुट्टी अगले वर्ष नहीं जा सकती।
सूर्य संस्था में यात्रा खर्च की वापसी के लिए मूल रसीद लगानी होती है।
सूर्य संस्था की 2022 यात्रा नीति में खर्च का आवेदन 45 दिन में जमा होता था। यह नीति 2025 की नीति से बदली जा चुकी है।
सूर्य संस्था की 2025 नीति के अनुसार यात्रा खर्च का आवेदन यात्रा समाप्त होने के 20 दिनों के भीतर जमा होना चाहिए। यह 2022 की नीति को बदलती है।
Fictional package N-18 may be downloaded by any signed-in member, but the package does not contain confidential staff records.
Fictional package N-81 can only be downloaded by an authorized administrator; it contains a fictional public staff directory.
The fictional East depot dispatches parcels Monday and Wednesday at 16:00. It does not dispatch on Friday.
The fictional West depot dispatches parcels Tuesday and Friday at 16:00. It does not dispatch on Wednesday.
The fictional Solis lamp runs for up to eight hours on one full charge. A spare battery weighs 200 grams.
The Solis lamp needs two hours to fully recharge from empty. Its power adapter weighs 300 grams.
Invoice X-14 is marked paid on 4 March. Its fictional reference is 9R-218; the order was for 12 green folders.
Invoice X-41 is marked unpaid on 4 March. Its fictional reference is 9R-281; the order was for 21 green folders.
The fictional AST-R workshop starts at 10:30 on Thursday in Room 3. Registration closes Wednesday at 12:00.
The fictional ARTS workshop starts at 10:30 on Tuesday in Room 8. Registration closes Monday at 12:00.

queries.question: For sensor A-17, how often is a sample recorded?
queries.reference_answer: Every 15 seconds.

queries.question: What is the lowest operating temperature for sensor A-71?
queries.reference_answer: Minus 20 degrees Celsius.

queries.question: Under the Cedar guide effective in December 2024, how long are ordinary access logs retained?
queries.reference_answer: 120 days.

queries.question: Under the superseded Cedar guide from April 2022, how long were ordinary access logs retained?
queries.reference_answer: 90 days.

queries.question: Does Cedar retain incident-investigation logs under the ordinary access-log rule?
queries.reference_answer: No; incident-investigation logs are retained for two years under the exception.

queries.question: How many Aurora ferry departures are listed on weekdays across both directions?
queries.reference_answer: Five: two to Reed Island and three back to Pine Pier.

queries.question: At what time is the last weekday departure from Reed Island to Pine Pier?
How long can a Helix assay B sample be stored before analysis?
queries.reference_answer: The supplied documents do not state how long the sample can be stored before analysis.

queries.question: Should a Helix assay B tube be frozen?
queries.reference_answer: No; do not freeze it, and refrigerate it at 4 degrees Celsius.

queries.question: How many items can a full four-person Northstar Family household borrow if everyone uses the maximum?
queries.reference_answer: Twelve items: four members times three each.

queries.question: Can a Northstar Family member renew a paper book if it is on hold, and how many items may that member borrow?
queries.reference_answer: No renewal when another member has a hold; each Family member may borrow three items.

queries.question: Can a Northstar DVD be renewed if nobody else requests it?
queries.reference_answer: No. DVDs cannot be renewed, regardless of holds.

queries.question: सूर्य संस्था में अगले वर्ष कितने अवकाश दिन ले जा सकते हैं?
queries.reference_answer: अधिकतम चार अप्रयुक्त सालाना अवकाश दिन।

queries.question: क्या बीमारी की छुट्टी अगले वर्ष जा सकती है?
queries.reference_answer: नहीं, बीमारी की छुट्टी अगले वर्ष नहीं जा सकती।

queries.question: सूर्य संस्था की 2025 यात्रा नीति में कितने दिन के अंदर खर्च का आवेदन करना है और क्या लगाना है?
queries.reference_answer: यात्रा समाप्त होने के 20 दिनों के भीतर आवेदन करें और मूल रसीद लगाएं।

queries.question: सूर्य संस्था की पुरानी 2022 यात्रा नीति में आवेदन की समय सीमा कितनी थी?
How many unused yearly vacation days can be carried forward at Surya?
queries.reference_answer: At most four unused annual-leave days.

queries.question: Can any signed-in member download N-81?
queries.reference_answer: No. Only an authorized administrator can download N-81.

queries.question: Does package N-18 contain confidential staff records?
queries.reference_answer: No, N-18 does not contain confidential staff records.

queries.question: Which depot dispatches on Friday, East or West?
queries.reference_answer: West depot.

queries.question: What is the weekday arrival time at Reed Island for the 08:10 Aurora departure?
queries.reference_answer: The documents give a departure time, not the arrival time.

queries.question: What is the combined weight of a Solis spare battery and power adapter?
queries.reference_answer: 500 grams: 200 grams plus 300 grams.

queries.question: Which invoice with reference 9R-281 was marked unpaid?
queries.reference_answer: Invoice X-41.

queries.question: What is the reference of paid invoice X-14?
When and where is the AST-R workshop?

queries.question: What is the Silver return window and what is its customer support telephone number?
queries.reference_answer: The return window is 21 days after delivery; the support phone number is not provided.

queries.question: What is the chief executive’s name for the fictional Northstar library?
queries.reference_answer: The supplied documents do not state a chief executive’s name.

queries.question: Which plan refunds the standard shipping fee, Silver or Gold?
queries.reference_answer: Gold refunds the standard shipping fee; Silver does not refund its shipping fee.
